note: Four contact rows, as OZ_PdaPageContacts creates them. Each name is one of the four marks Row() glues after YOUR OWN name, written as its key alone: the engine translates a string that BEGINS with a key, so a key behind a name would stay raw. A language round then renders all four -- the only still that can show them, and what keeps them short: the name column is 260 units and the first wording of the widest mark drew 308.
